annotations.title: Design conditions (ASHRAE method or EPW.tools Enhanced)

description:
Heating and cooling design conditions for any site, free, in one of two modes that are never mixed.

mode="ashrae_method": the ASHRAE Handbook Ch. 14 method replicated at the nearest ASHRAE station for the
chosen edition (2025, 2021, 2017, 2013, 2009, 2005); validated about 0.25 degC from the published tables.
mode="enhanced": EPW.tools Enhanced, not the ASHRAE method: values at the site itself for today's climate
with a tested 90 % range. The DDY file for Enhanced costs 1 credit through the web or the API.
name: get_design_conditions
